newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch.

text.p: Stocks to watch this morning: * Signet Banking Corp reported third quarter earnings per share of $0.49, against $0.50 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.51. The stock closed at 27 on Wednesday.
* AMR Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $1.36, compared to $1.10 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 81-3/4.
* McDonnell Douglas Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.91, compared to $0.85 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 45-5/8.
* AT&T Corp reported third quarter operating earnings of $0.84 a share, compared to $0.96 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.83. The stock closed at 39-7/8.
* ITT Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.55, compared to $0.56 in the year-ago period, according to First Call. The stock closed at 42-7/8.
* KeyCorp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.95, compared to $0.90 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 44-1/4.
* Allstate Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.54, compared to $0.90 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 51-3/8.
* Tandy Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.34, compared to $0.66 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 40.
* Bankers Trust New York Corp reported third quarter earnings per share of $1.99, compared to $1.72 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $1.69. The stock closed at 83.
* Bristol-Myers Squibb Co is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $1.48, compared to $1.36 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 101.
* Iomega Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.07, compared to $0.02 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 25-55/64.
* Dial Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.13, compared to $0.45 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 14-1/8.
